prompt.project_info: Adapted from the source galaxy-themed ice cream prompt.
prompt.main_subject: One massive spherical scoop of frozen creamy galaxy ice cream with marbled indigo, midnight blue, black, cyan, magenta, purple, gold and white cosmic swirls.
prompt.composition_elements: Single hero scoop centered in a clean product composition, rippled creamy surface, slight melting sheen, star-like speckles, edible gold dust and subtle cosmic backdrop.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Controlled studio light with glossy highlights and whimsical deep-space atmosphere.
prompt.technical_specs: High-resolution product photography, sharp texture, realistic frozen cream, restrained depth of field and accurate color separation.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Photorealistic product image of one massive spherical scoop of galaxy-themed ice cream, frozen creamy dense texture with marbled indigo, midnight blue, black, cyan, magenta, purple, gold and white swirls, tiny star-like speckles, edible gold dust and slight melting sheen, centered hero composition, controlled studio light, whimsical cosmic atmosphere, no text or logos.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, exposed body, exposed breasts, exposed genitals, child, minor, melted sludge, plastic texture, distorted sphere, watermark, text, logo
